description: A satellite image showcasing a traditional irrigated agricultural area in Saka, Anatolia, Turkey, captured on 2011-09-06 by the Spot 5 satellite at 2.5 m resolution. The image is presented as a false-colour composite using band combination 1/2/3 (likely RGB mapping to green, red, and near-infrared, respectively), where actively vegetated areas, characteristic of summer-time irrigated crops, appear in vivid shades of red. A large, dark blue body of water, likely a river or lake, occupies the lower portion of the image. Adjacent to the water and extending inland are numerous regular, small-to-medium sized agricultural parcels, many exhibiting the bright red of actively growing crops. Interspersed among these are parcels of lighter brown or grey, possibly representing non-irrigated land, fallow fields, or bare soil. In the upper-central part of the image, a dense cluster of bright white and light blue/grey features indicates a village or settlement with associated infrastructure, consistent with typical traditional irrigated areas. The image source is CNES 2011©, Distribution Airbus DS/Spot Image.
